Bill.BriefDescription: Providing property tax exemptions for farmers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to property tax exemptions for farmers; adding anew section to chapter 84.36 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The following property is exempt from property taxes: (a) Motor fuel owned by a farmer; and (b) Personal property owned by a farmer used for the maintenance offarm machinery and equipment. (2)(a) "Farmer" has the same meaning as defined in RCW 82.04.213. (b) "Farm machinery and equipment" means machinery and equipmentused exclusively in growing and producing agricultural products.
This act applies to taxes levied forcollection in 2005 and thereafter.
